Extract evidence separately from precedence. Role-specific attendance outranks generic WFH metadata or recruiter hashtags. Handle negation, technical hybrid cloud language, employer boilerplate, travel, temporal conditions, and multiple options. Preserve rule/evidence/confidence/conflict audit fields.
